title: Desk
description: Settings of Desk, the decider's card desk: desk.toml in desk's home folder, read by desk on every redraw. Written from desk's own desk.toml.example (git blob c5fc68e), which documents every key desk accepts; desk refuses a key it does not know, so this schema does too. Every key is optional to parse; a command that needs a missing one stops and names it. Values are double-quoted strings with no backslash or quote inside, or lists of them. Installed beside the file as .desk.schema.json; that install is a live act and waits for a go.

packs.title: Packs
packs.description: The folder of kind packs, one subfolder per kind holding kind.json, card.html and answer.json. A relative path is under desk's home; `~` is not expanded here, so write a home folder in full. Default: packs under the home. DESK_PACKS wins over it.
packs.x-hint: The folder of kind packs. A change needs a new app sent to chat 12.

trusted_chats.title: Trusted chats
trusted_chats.description: The chat seats whose taps the desk believes; a tap from any other seat is not acted on. An empty list counts as missing, and a blank entry is refused. Needed by ingest.

ask_senders.title: Ask senders
ask_senders.description: Who may send asks: an ask is drawn only when the local part of its From address is listed. [] is a choice: no ask is drawn at all. Absent: every sender draws, and each run warns.

card_max_width.title: Card width
card_max_width.description: The widest the card column grows, written "<n>px", n a whole number from 320 to 1600. A phone narrower than that stays fluid. Default: "640px". Changing it changes the app: the next push rebuilds spool/desk.xdc and says a resend is due.
card_max_width.x-hint: 320px to 1600px. A change needs a new app sent to chat 12.

decider.title: Decider
decider.description: The name of the person whose desk this is: written on each decision as Atom-Authority, and only asks addressed to this name (or to no one) are shown. The --decider flag wins over it.

state_box.title: State box
state_box.description: The mail box whose state/in-flight atom heads the desk. The --state-box flag wins over it.

reply_box.title: Reply box
reply_box.description: The mail box that decisions are sent to. Needed by ingest.

fallback_area.title: Fallback area
fallback_area.description: The area that a card with no area pointer falls to. Needed by render and focus.

registry_cmd.title: Registry command
registry_cmd.description: The program that lists the areas as JSON; desk runs it as `<registry_cmd> --json`, so a path to one executable, not a command line. A leading ~/ becomes $HOME. The --registry FILE flag wins over it.

outbox.title: Outbox
outbox.description: The chat daemon's outbox folder, where desk drops the .xdcupdate files that carry the desk to the phone. A leading ~/ becomes $HOME. The --outbox flag wins over it.

chat_log.title: Chat log
chat_log.description: The chat daemon's log file, which resend reads to learn the message id of the app it sent. A leading ~/ becomes $HOME. DESK_CHAT_LOG wins over it.

send_cmd.title: Send command
send_cmd.description: The program that sends a chat message: a path to one executable, not a command line. A leading ~/ becomes $HOME. DESK_SEND_CMD wins over it.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The chat channel that resend sends the app to. The --channel flag, then DESK_CHAT_CHANNEL, win over it.
